entities.label: Kirk
entities.notes: Captain and log voice in this derivative text; not a globally reconciled identity.

entities.label: Charles Evans / Charlie
entities.notes: Passenger described as a human adolescent and crash survivor; claims about personal history and abilities require their own evidence.

entities.label: Yeoman Janice Rand
entities.notes: Expresses boundaries, requests help and later is referred to by others during an apparent absence.

entities.label: Spock
entities.notes: Officer making analytical and sensor claims; one later text segment suggests speech interference.

entities.label: McCoy
entities.notes: Medical officer; dialogue labels are editorial attributions, not independent voice authentication.

entities.label: Uhura
entities.notes: Communications reports include Antares contact, loss of transmissions and a later Thasian message.

entities.label: Captain Ramart
entities.notes: Antares captain who transfers Charlie and later makes an interrupted warning.

entities.label: Tom Nellis
entities.notes: Navigator introduced by Ramart; no global identification inferred.

entities.label: Tina Lawton
entities.notes: Rand introduces Tina as an age-near peer, and Charlie rejects the introduction.

entities.label: Sam
entities.notes: Participant in the gym demonstration; later Kirk and Charlie discuss an apparent disappearance. Transcript lacks confirming staging.

entities.label: THASIAN-labeled interlocutor
entities.notes: Final contact speaks for a Thasian collective; neither physical nature nor truth of testimony is independently authenticated.

entities.label: Thasians as reported
entities.notes: Legend/hypothesis in crew dialogue, and an asserted collective in a later THASIAN-labeled statement.

entities.label: Antares
entities.notes: Transfer ship, later reported lost; cause is first hypothetical, then subject of Charlie's admission and Thasian testimony.

entities.label: Enterprise
entities.notes: Ship and setting of crew decisions in the candidate transcript.

entities.label: Thasus
entities.notes: Location associated in attributed accounts with Charlie's reported isolation and Thasian survival assistance.

entities.label: Colony Five / Colony Alpha Five
entities.notes: Proposed destination; text uses two names, not independently reconciled beyond local context.

entities.label: People reported missing or restored
entities.notes: Crew losses and reversals are speech- and report-relative; no individual/global identity restoration edges created.

entities.label: Ship communications and sensors
entities.notes: Instrument/status reports in dialogue are not an independently inspected system log.

entities.label: Three-dimensional chess board and pieces
entities.notes: Participants describe a game and unusual piece behavior, without an authenticated visual staging witness.

entities.label: Attributed ability to alter or remove things
entities.notes: A source-local topic assembled from testimony and reports; not a distinct canonical ontological entity.
